Colors show as a row of small swatches, all of them reachable. On a narrow card the row scrolls sideways with the last swatch cut off and the edge faded, so shoppers can tell there are more. Hovering a swatch previews that color’s photo after a short pause and preloads it, so the crossfade never shows a blank frame. Clicking it picks the color: the price, badges and stock follow it, and the link opens the product page with ?color= set. On a mouse, hovering the card crossfades to a second photo.

Product Card & grid for React & shadcn/ui

Product Card is the tile you put in a collection grid, search results or a recommendations rail. It takes a Product, the same model Variant Picker uses, and shows one card per product, never one per color. The whole card is a single link on the title, while the heart, swatches and quick add stay separate buttons on top of it.

Put compact cards in a horizontally scrolling list for “You may also like” or “Complete the look”. Each card keeps its own swatches and quick add, so the rail needs no extra state.

Quick add fits the product. A product with one variant gets an Add to bag button that keeps its width while it changes to a spinner, Added or Couldn’t add. A product with sizes shows a row of size buttons that slides up over the photo on hover or keyboard focus, with sold-out sizes crossed out. On touch screens a + button opens a bottom sheet with Variant Picker instead. A sold-out product hides quick add, shows a Sold out badge and a Notify me link.
